Chapter 562 - 562 Success; Creating A Sun!

Chapter 562 - 562 Success; Creating a Sun!

562 Success; Creating a Sun!

Ordinary 1 let out a soft sound.

Then, the numbers on the screen began to jump rapidly.

Two million megavolts!

Five million megavolts!

Ten million megavolts!

30 million megavolts!

When the experts saw these numbers, their eyes widened in disbelief.

Someone could not help but exclaim, “How is this possible?!”

The crowd did not look at him with blame or surprise.

They also had the same shock and doubt.

One had to know…

A medium-sized city would only consume 30 to 50 million megavolts of electricity every day.

Now, it could generate 30 million megavolts of electricity with just one ton of hydrogen!

Deuterated water was a solution that could be easily extracted from seawater.

Seawater occupied more than 70% of the earth’s surface area.

Therefore, the supply of it was inexhaustible.

It could generate so much electricity.

If it was true, then… the entire world would no longer have to worry about energy!

At this moment, Feng Zhixiang’s phone suddenly rang.

Feng Zhixiang wanted to reject.

However, when he saw that it was Jiao Yang, he still picked up.

“Director Feng, I’ve already asked someone to turn off the power supply in the Summer and Lake Districts, but for some reason, the Summer and Lake Districts suddenly have electricity again. I’ve already asked someone to check,” Jiao Yang asked.

The power supply was turned off, but there was electricity!

They had succeeded!

Ordinary 1’s test was a success!

It really generated 30 million megavolts of electricity!

“Good, great!” Feng Zhixiang exclaimed excitedly. “Hahaha!”

After a while, he seemed to realize that the call had not been hung up. He quickly said, “Leader Jiao, you just need to maintain the current state.”

Jiao Yang was still at a loss, so he could only reply, “Alright.”

Then, the entire workshop was filled with excited exclamations.

“Too unbelievable!”

“Heavens!”

“A miracle!”

“I actually witnessed it with my own eyes!”

“It’s a success! The controllable nuclear fusion is a success!”

…

When some people called out, hot tears even flowed out of the corners of their eyes.

They were experts in controllable nuclear fusion and had been working hard for this technology for most of their lives. They were the group of people who hoped that this technology could be realized as soon as possible.

Now, it had finally succeeded!

“Professor Lin, thank you!”

“Thank you!”

Everyone bowed to Lin Fan and thanked him.

Lin Fan suddenly received such big bows from elders many years his senior. He scratched the back of his head in embarrassment and said, “This is just a small matter. You don’t have to do this.

“Oh right, these are the manuals, blueprints, and principles of Ordinary 1.”

As he spoke, Lin Fan handed over a stack of documents.

Feng Zhixiang took the information and bowed 90 degrees to Lin Fan. “Professor Lin, thank you! I know that what you’ve done is not something that can be expressed with just thanks…

“However, I can’t find any other way for the time being.

“Thank you!”

After saying that, he bowed toward Lin Fan once more.

“Also, Professor Lin, don’t worry. This is your technology and patent. When people use it, they’ll pay for it!”

Clearly, this was for Lin Fan’s benefit.

This kind of technology would undoubtedly set off a huge wave in the energy field.

Without a doubt…

The wind power, firepower, and even the water power stations would pale in comparison to Ordinary 1.

He could foresee that in the future… Hua Nation, and even most of the world, would be using controllable nuclear fusion electricity.

There would definitely be a bountiful profit from this!

“Alright,” said Lin Fan.

He no longer cared about money.

It was just a few more zeros or a few fewer zeros.

After a pause, he said, “Alright, you guys can study it slowly. I’ll leave first.”

After saying that, he did not stay any longer and walked straight out.

For the next few days, Lin Fan stayed in the Coiling Dragon Villa to rest quietly.

According to past experience, every time he received a reward, many people would come to congratulate him and chat with him. It was very troublesome.

Lin Fan hated trouble.

Lin Fan rested quietly, but the entire world was in a commotion because of him.

The success of controllable nuclear fusion was officially announced.

…

On Weibo.

Don’t Forget, Don’t Forget! [Controlled nuclear fusion? Am I seeing things? Furthermore, it was invented by God Lin Fan?!]

Hero: [I thought it was a work of fiction. I didn’t expect it to turn into reality so quickly! Professor Lin is awesome!]

Li Bai: [When my mentor saw this news, he cried on the spot!]

Waiter: [It wasn’t easy for me to accept the fact that God Lin Fan solved Zhou’s Conjecture, the Twin Prime Number Conjecture, and other mathematical problems. He even invented the earthquake prediction device.

[It wasn’t easy for me to accept that God Lin Fan invented the earthquake prediction device. In the end, he invented the super battery.

[It wasn’t easy for me to accept that God Lin Fan invented the super battery. In the end, he invented the carbon-based photolithographic machine.

[It wasn’t easy for me to accept that God Lin Fan invented the carbon-based photolithographic machine. In the end, he invented the human islet recovery drug.

[I finally accepted that God Lin Fan invented the human islet recovery drug, and now he invented the controllable nuclear fusion device?!

[Finally, I just want to say that God Lin Fan is awesome!]

Sinking: [Didn’t Lin Fan just win four Nobel Prizes? What kind of big event is this?]

Confused: [May I ask, what is controllable nuclear fusion?]

Gudmore: [This world is constantly reminding me that I came to the human world to make up the numbers.]

I Know, I Know: [Why is the difference between people so big?]

Firmament: [It seems that there are still people who don’t know what controllable nuclear fusion is. Let me give a simple explanation.

[Controlled nuclear fusion is the process of fusing two lighter nuclei into a heavier nucleus and releasing energy.

[For example, the sun is able to emit sunlight because it’s undergoing controllable nuclear fusion.

[Therefore, controllable nuclear fusion is also known as the Little Sun.

[In addition, the main material used in this controllable nuclear fusion was extracted from seawater. It can be said that there’s an endless supply.

[Some people said that the main problem that has been plaguing human development is the problem of energy!

[And now, our energy problem can be said to have been fundamentally solved!]

Flowers Blossoms: [So you’re saying that God Lin Fan created the sun?]

Stone Golem: [F*ck, awesome!]

Disheartened: [F*ck, awesome!]

Awoo: [F*ck, awesome!]
